text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder finished the Nippon Derby—a 
race crowded with powerful 
competitors—with a proud and commendable 
result.

After the match, an unsatisfied El Condor 
Pasa came over to challenge her to a 
rematch at the Japan Cup.

Grass Wonder agonized over whether to 
enter a race she hadn't originally planned 
to run. Just then, Maruzensky casually 
dropped by to see her.

She walks away after leaving provocative 
words for Grass Wonder, suggesting that El 
Condor Pasa might truly be the 
"Second-Generation Monster."

Taking those words to heart, Grass Wonder 
shook off her doubts and resolved to 
accept El Condor Pasa's challenge.
